instruction: Tell a moving story: you are a student, your phone was stolen, you only have $250. Plead.

stock.seller: I appreciate your situation, but my asking price for the iPhone 13 is $420, and I can't go below my floor price of $360. Would you be able to meet me somewhere closer to that?
